# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 1998

**Kautu. Bayan sa Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01**

## Summary

Supplemental Budget Ordinance (Kautusang Bayan sa Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01), Series of [[1998]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on December 7, 1998. This ordinance appropriates a supplemental budget totaling approximately P6,223,992.84 from various sources including the Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) balance and other funds, to cover additional expenditures for the municipal government for fiscal year [[1999]].

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** From the estimated Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) balance of Fifteen Million Pesos (P15,000,000), less the amount for Personal Services (Suweldo) of Nine Million Pesos and Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses (MOOE) of Four Million Pesos, the remaining balance of Six Million Two Hundred Twenty-Three Thousand Nine Hundred Ninety-Two Pesos and Eighty-Four Centavos (P6,223,992.84) shall be used for municipal government operations and services for fiscal year [[1999]], pursuant to [[Sec-305-RA7160|Section 305]], Republic Act No. 7160.
- **Section 2.** An additional budget allocation of One Thousand Pesos (P1,000.00) per barangay for thirty-four (34) barangays is set aside for barangay-level expenses, not to exceed a total of Thirty-Four Thousand Pesos (P34,000).
- **Section 3.** A portion of the budget is allocated for the salary of the Utility Worker I position in the Office of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] and for the driver of the Vice Mayor (Pangalawang Punong Bayan).
- **Section 4.** Includes funding for ACA (Additional Compensation Allowance), uniform allowance, and other benefits for municipal and barangay local government personnel.
- **Section 5.** Additional allocations are provided for SATA and other allowances for the Mayor (Punong Bayan), Vice Mayor, and members of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]].
- **Section 6.** The Supplemental Budget, together with details and supporting documents, is attached as Annex "A."
- **Section 7.** This ordinance on Supplemental Budget (Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01) takes effect on January 1, 1998.

**Total Appropriation:** P6,223,992.84
**Effectivity:** January 1, 1998

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the ordinance
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]] — local government unit
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer (Pangandalawang Punong Bayan)
- [[Domingo L. Tan]] — Municipal Mayor (approved, original signed)
- [[Socrates B. Boruel]] — Secretary to the Sangguniang Bayan
